arStrings.szText:
When a {c_important}{u}{b}Hellwyrm{/c}{/u}{/b} emerges, it unleashes one of the following:

{icon:bullet,1.2} A {c_important}Chaos Rift{/c}, which releases varied rewards upon collapse.
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_important}Maggots{/c}, which burst out {c_important}Experience Orbs{/c} when slain.
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_important}Bloodseekers{/c}, which are more likely to drop {c_important}Ancestral{/c} items when slain.
